Your log is saved on this phone. Signing in opens a separate log for that account; this one stays here and returns when you sign out and choose Get started.

HeatShield uses forecasts, not measurements at your site. There\'s no legal stop-work temperature in Victoria, but your employer must still control heat risks. Your crew\'s rule and your team leader\'s directions come before HeatShield\'s levels, and anyone with signs of heat illness stops work whatever the temperature. HeatShield doesn\'t diagnose heat illness.
